name: Chat Themes
description: Instagram-style themes per conversation: backgrounds with colors, gradients, images, videos, patterns and animated effects, shared by every member.

settings_schema.header: Every member of a conversation can change its theme; everybody in it sees the same background.

settings.help_text: Largest image, GIF or video users can upload as a background (1-50). Still images are shrunk in the browser before uploading, so this mostly limits GIFs and videos.

settings.display_name: Allow external image and video URLs
settings.help_text: Let users point a background at an https:// URL instead of uploading it. Every member's browser then loads it from that site.
